videodb.description: VideoDB lets an AI agent watch, search and clip video. Works in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and any MCP client. Uses OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in, so no API key is needed. Steps for every client: https://docs.videodb.io/pages/mcp/connect?utm_source=github.com/davila7/claude-code-templates&utm_medium=directory
